[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1if[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Plugin commands — sase listen as the first first-class command [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]plugin[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Plugins can mount top-level `sase <name>` commands through a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]metadata-declared `sase_commands` entry point. sase-listen uses it [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]to ship `sase listen`, which behaves exactly like `sase-listen`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completes in bash/zsh/fish and the TUI `:` line, refreshes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completion automatically on every plugin change, and is installed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and managed from the Admin Center's Updates tab. Every moment a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]plugin adds or removes a command is announced clearly and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]consistently.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
